newsitem.title: FRANCE: France outlines export bids for wheat, barley. [CORRECTED 14:35 GMT]
newsitem.headline: France outlines export bids for wheat, barley. [CORRECTED 14:35 GMT]

text.p: Traders bid through France for both subsidised and taxed wheat exports in a main European Union tender and for subsidised wheat in a tender for African, Caribbean and Pacific nations, French cereals office ONIC said.
They also sought unspecified export subsidies for exports of 35,000 tonnes of free-market barley, it said.
Following is the breakdown of bids. Bids for taxes or refunds (ref.) are in Ecus per tonne.
MAIN TENDER Tonnage Range of Bids Tonnage Range of Bids
Soft wheat 50,000 Ref., not given 45,000 0.87-3.27 Ref.
